name: Single Leg Romanian Deadlift
instructions: Stand on one leg holding a dumbbell in the opposite hand, knee slightly bent.
Hinge at the hip, sending your free leg back behind you.
Lower until your torso is near parallel with the floor.
Squeeze your glute to return to standing.
longevityNotes: Hip-hinge strength protects the lower back in every lift, from groceries to grandchildren. Strong glutes and hamstrings are the engine of walking, climbing, and standing up.
overview: A single-leg hip hinge that trains the hamstrings, glutes and balance.
